item.title: The Thrill Is Gone: Airbnb and the Crisis of Imagination in Short-Term Rentals
item.description: Airbnb’s struggle to translate technology into better stays mirrors the broader sector’s problem — digital scale without physical control limits how innovative short-term rentals can be.

item.title: Skift Megatrends NYC Draws Travel Leaders Looking for Clarity on 2026
item.description: Data, executive storytelling, and candid debate come together at Skift Travel Megatrends 2026. London is sold out. Register now for NYC.

item.title: The Rebalancing of Travel and Decline of Brand Loyalty
item.description: Travel demand isn’t slowing — it’s being rebalanced across markets while AI is quietly rewriting how loyalty is earned and lost.

item.title: Carnival CEO to Lead Cruise Group, Says Emissions Cuts Are a Priority
item.description: Now that the cruise industry has moved past its pandemic recovery, Carnival CEO and chief climate officer Josh Weinstein’s focus on greenhouse gas emissions marks a notable shift, especially as the sector faces intensifying scrutiny over its environmental impact.

item.title: The Louvre Levies a 45% Price Hike on Most Visitors
item.description: The Louvre enacted a steep price hike, but its officials must believe the added cost won't discourage visits to one of the world's most famous museums. It's counting on more than $23 million in added revenue.

item.title: Airbnb Builds Hotel Team to Take On the OTAs
item.description: For years people have wondered whether Airbnb's business is doomed as it faces increased regulation around the world. Airbnb has an answer to getting shut out in that manner — hotels, hotels, hotels.

item.title: OpenAI is Testing ChatGPT Ads — Travel Brands Should Pay Attention
item.description: OpenAI is finally turning on the revenue taps by piloting ads in its free and low-cost tiers. For travel brands, it means ChatGPT is moving from a pure utility to a massive, intent-driven marketing platform.

item.title: A Rare Defense of ‘Eurobusiness’ Class
item.description: Viewed from the lemonade-not-lemons perspective, Europe's short-haul business class does at least bring flexible capacity to the (tray) table.

item.title: The Validation Economy: How Western Travel Creators Monetize South Asia’s Need to Be Seen
item.description: This is a preview of where travel media is headed: destinations as identity theaters and creators as roaming interfaces between cultures and the algorithm.

item.title: IHG to Bring the Vignette Collection to India: Exclusive
item.description: IHG bringing the Vignette Collection to India isn’t just about adding another brand name to its portfolio. It’s a sign that India is no longer only about mid-market hotels doing the heavy lifting. There’s now enough demand, confidence and spending power for luxury hotels to co-exist with them.
